name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting a general contractor, gather your property survey, identify your functional goals, document your ideal layout features, and establish a clear preliminary investment range. Check your property boundary markers or plat map so you have a general sense of available yard space and potential easement restrictions. List your top priorities, such as whether you need seating for six at an island, space for a double oven, or a walk-in scullery. Having these functional requirements and your appliance preferences ready allows the contractor to evaluate structural feasibility and provide accurate design guidance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your property survey, a prioritized list of layout needs, preferred appliance dimensions, and a clear budget range to discuss project feasibility.
